messages:
nina: Quick thread: we need a lightweight governance layer for saved-query previews. Teams keep saving queries with 'prefer lowest-latency' hint and then wonder why cost blew past quota. Idea: add a small "preview scorecard" visible in the console that summarizes route risk, cost, and audit trail.

omar: +1. Scorecard fields suggestion: predicted_model, predicted_latency_ms_range, estimated_tokens_per_run, monthly_projection, risk_tag (low/medium/high), and last_route_audit_id.

lee: backend: we currently only store route_id and query blob. Storing monthly_projection would require an estimation job. We can generate a lightweight estimate from recent telemetry + a synthetic sample run. Costs should be strings/numbers only in API.

hana: UX: show scorecard inline on saved query card with micro-CTA "Run detailed sim". If risk_tag==high show :warning: and a 'safety checklist' modal. Keep default compact.

nina: governance rules: (1) only billing-admins can set cost_override on a saved query; (2) product users can add preferred_model_hint but it becomes read-only if the query exceeds org_budget_threshold.

omar: API suggestion: POST /api/v2/saved_queries/:id/preview_score -> returns {score_id, predicted_model, est_tokens_per_run, est_cost_per_1000, risk_level, audit_id, generated_at}. Keep values flat.

lee: implementation: preview generation is a short job that reads current routing policies (region, tier, canaries) and runs a synthetic micro-sample through the routing simulator. We'll cache result for 3m by default. We should expose cache_ttl_seconds in response.

hana: UX nuance: show both "preferred" (user hint) and "predicted/effective" (what routing sim returns) with tiny pills. If they differ, show a tooltip explaining why (quota, capacity, rollout). Tooltip links to route audit.

nina: audit trail: when preview job runs it should create a small audit entry with id audit-<ts>-<rand>. That id surfaces on the scorecard and links to /console/audits/:id which shows the routing policy snapshot used to compute prediction. Important for compliance.

omar: telemetry: attach preview_sample_id and preview_generation_id to the audit so we can join with later real traffic to compute divergence metrics. We'll emit preview.coverage_ratio and preview.divergence_count.

lee: auth/ACL: separate resource /saved_query_scorecards is nice because infra can rotate cost_override without changing query content. Also easier to apply RBAC. Nina ?
nina: yes separate resource. Policy: only roles with "scorecard.edit" can change risk_tag or cost_override. Write these into a dedicated table and reference saved_query.id.

hana: small UX edgecases: if saved_query references a private route, show a lock icon and a CTA "request route access". If projection is stale (>1h) show stale badge and CTA "recompute preview".

omar: perf: consoles listing many saved queries should call a bulk scorecard endpoint: POST /api/v2/saved_query_scorecards/bulk_lookup with ids up to 100 -> returns compact rows: id, score_id, risk_level, est_cost_label, cache_ttl_seconds. This avoids many routing simulator calls.

lee: we'll add circuit-breaker: if routing-sim queue depth > N, bulk_lookup returns partial results + partial=true and a retry_after_seconds. Console should show a subtle "results streaming" indicator.

nina: next steps: lee + omar spec DB table and endpoints; hana to mock inline scorecard and modal; i'll write short RFC and include acceptance criteria: must surface audit_id on scorecards and enforce RBAC for cost_override.

infra-bot: Feature flag "scorecard-preview" created, default OFF for prod.

nina: thanks all — ping me on PRs. We'll aim for a tiny beta behind flag first.
